hazards.description: Every creature in the Ada world, assembled in one place. 69 entities across 16 themed sections. The original collection â€” origami folders, sphere rollers, wall-crawlers, grid agents, procedural legs, companions â€” now joined by 30 sequence-specific creatures. Each new creature embodies the algorithm of its home sequence through geometry and behavior: a binary search tree that walks on its leaves, a gradient descent predator stuck in local minima, an Escher figure on impossible stairs. Mathematics given teeth.
hazards.qfep_connection: Hazards embody the tension between entropy and form. Each creature is a topology â€” a body that folds, rolls, extends, or shapeshifts. The personality progression from foe to friend mirrors the Q-FEP insight: same potential, different relational context, different manifestation. The force field that burns also warms. The plasma that shocks also heals. Constraint determines outcome.

artifact_groups.rationale: Origami bestiary: Miura crawlers, Kresling spires, kaleidocycles, scissor stalkers, sphere droidekas, waterbombs. Mathematics of folding given locomotion — rigid-foldable tessellations as creature bodies.

Crawlers and energy creatures: octapod surface traversal, waterbomb hopping, plasma critters, force fields. Grid agents introduce nine behavioral modes — dual-nature forms where the hazard contains its own medicine.
Procedural legs progression: one through eight legs, watching gaits emerge from limb count. Block builders, tech striders, tentacle cubes — special creatures where geometry determines locomotion.

Items, companions, and data structure creatures: index sentinels (arrays), data tree walkers (BST), graph weavers, hull crushers. Plus edible mushroom, stick tool, proximity spawner, and the Catalyst — personality progression from foe to friend.

Physics and nature creatures: wave riders, spring mass bouncers, collision crashers, joint articulators embody physics simulation. Branching vines, fractal hydras, recursion spirals, swarm hives, lifeform walkers — algorithms given teeth.

AI, stochastic, and spatial field creatures: gradient hunters stuck in local minima, grammar Markov chains, maze spinners, paradox stalkers. Noise fields, Voronoi partitions, isosurface traps, constraint webs — space itself becomes hazardous.

Higher math and art creatures: tesseract phasers (4D), Escher stairwalkers (impossible geometry), mesh morphers (topology), bricoleur golems (improvisation), QFEP calibrators. Pattern mines, resonance chambers, particle emitters — the bestiary's conceptual capstone.
